question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the share of valid votes cast nationwide for Vox candidacies, including any coalition in which Vox is the lead partner, in the November 29, 2026 election to the Congress of Deputies, in percent to one decimal place, per the proclaimed results published by the Junta Electoral Central, the Ministry of the Interior or [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions), after any recounts.

# Vox vote share, Spain general election of 29 November 2026: research notes

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the official Congress results from the Ministry of the Interior (results site) or the Junta Electoral Central. Results are proclaimed after the 29 November vote and the CERA (overseas) count. Blank ballots count as valid votes. No 2026 results exist yet, because the vote has not happened.
- 2023-07-23: Vox won 12.4% of valid votes, with PP on 33.1% and PSOE on 31.7%. (from the question's background)
- 2026-10-28: Candidate lists were published in the BOE. [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/andalucia/cordoba/doce-candidaturas-disputan-seis-escanos-cordoba-generales-29n_202611026ae818f3004b78127abccd60.html)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The election is 26 days away.
- Polls consistently put Vox at about 18-20%, well above its 2023 result.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-03: Vox asked the JEC to make the government publish mail-in vote data in real time. [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/vox-pide-junta-electoral-que-haga-publicos-datos-voto-correo-que-moncloa-recibe-tiempo-real_202611036ae9d84fb55c427e2ebd5f33.html)
- 2026-11-03: PolitPro's weighted trend has Vox at 18.7%, up 6.3 points on 2023 and up 1.6 points over three months. [PolitPro](https://politpro.eu/es/espana)
- 2026-11-03: Sondaxe (fieldwork 26-28 Oct) has PP 29.2%, PSOE 26.9%, Vox 19.2%. [Infobae](https://www.infobae.com/espana/2026/11/03/el-pp-ganaria-las-elecciones-con-23-puntos-de-ventaja-sobre-el-psoe-y-vox-seria-la-fuerza-que-mas-crece-segun-la-ultima-encuesta-antes-del-accidente-de-trenes-en-toledo/), [Demócrata](https://www.democrata.es/en/politics/sondaxe-survey-pp-leads-psoe-by-23-points-and-vox-reaches-192-one-month-before-the-elections/)
- 2026-11-01: The Objective reported a supposed internal Vox poll giving Vox 20.2% and 67-71 seats. Vox denies the poll exists. [The Objective](https://theobjective.com/espana/2026-11-01/sondeo-vox-71-escanos/), [Demócrata](https://www.democrata.es/encuestas/elecciones-generales/encuesta-elecciones-generales-sondeo-interno-vox-anterior-urda-situa-psoe-por-delante-pp-pero-mantiene-mayoria-derecha/)
- 2026-11-01/02: SocioMétrica has PP 32.7% and PSOE 26.6%, with PP+Vox on 203 seats. [El Español](https://www.elespanol.com/espana/politica/20261102/tragedia-urda-pp-vox-hoy-opciones-lograr-mayoria-quintos-senado/1003744443526_0.html)
- Late October: Demócrata reports that, after the Urda crash, the average of five pollsters for Vox rose from 19.2% to 19.5% ("Vox ya roza el 20%", 67 seats on average). I could not open the page (HTTP 403). [Demócrata](https://www.democrata.es/encuestas/elecciones-generales/vox-encuestas-tras-urda-20-por-ciento-67-escanos-29n/)
- Latest polls listed on PolitPro, all with Vox in a 18.2-20.0% band: [PolitPro](https://politpro.eu/es/espana)
  - Target Point (30 Oct): 19.9%
  - EM-Analytics (30 Oct): 19.2%
  - Sigma Dos (30 Oct): 19.3%
  - NC Report (29 Oct): 19.3%
  - Hamalgama (28 Oct): 19.9%
  - Winston (23 Oct): 19.2%
  - Ateneo del Dato (22 Oct): 19.8%

  - SocioMétrica (11 Oct): 18.8%
  - 40dB, Invymark and GESOP (8 Oct): 18.9%, 18.8% and 18.9%

- 2026-10-28: The Urda train crash killed 69 people. Sigma Dos found it hurt the PSOE. [TRT](https://www.trthaber.com/haber/dunya/ispanyadaki-tren-kazasi-erken-genel-secim-oncesi-anketlerde-sosyalistlerin-oyunu-dusurdu-961940.html)

- 2026-10-05: Sánchez called the early election after his housing decrees failed. [20minutos](https://www.20minutos.es/nacional/quien-ganara-elecciones-29-noviembre-segun-encuestas-sondeos_7044112_0.html)
- 2026-11-02: CIS microdata analysis shows Vox ahead of PP among 18-24-year-olds. [20minutos](https://www.20minutos.es/nacional/que-partidos-votan-mas-jovenes-asi-evolucionado-apoyo-politico-elecciones-2023_7056171_0.html)

## 4. Base rates
- Vox's general election results: 0.2% (2015 and 2016), 10.3% (April 2019), 15.1% (November 2019), 12.4% (2023).
- How final polls compared with results. These figures are from my memory and I have not checked them for this report:
  - April 2019: polls had Vox at roughly 11-13%, so they overestimated it.
  - November 2019: polls had it at roughly 13-14%, so they underestimated it by about 1-2 points.
  - 2023: polls had it at roughly 13-14%, so they overestimated it by about 1-1.5 points.
- The final polling error on Vox has typically been ±1-2 points, in either direction.
- The polling average has been fairly flat lately: about 19.0% at its February 2026 peak, about 18.8% in October, and about 19.2-19.5% after Urda.

## 5. Other forecasts
- **Polymarket**, "Vox % of vote" (2026-11-03): this matches the question.

  | Range | Probability |
  |---|---|
  | <16% | 1% |
  | 16-18% | 24% |
  | 18-20% | 40.5% |
  | 20-22% | 21% |
  | 22%+ | 6.5% |

  Implied median is about 19%.
- **Kalshi**, Vox vote percent: this also matches the question, though I have not checked whether Kalshi's settlement treats blank votes the same way.

  | Threshold | Probability |
  |---|---|
  | ≥16% | 94% |
  | ≥17% | 81% |
  | ≥18% | 64% |
  | ≥19% | 51% |
  | ≥20% | 33% |
  | ≥21% | 18% |
  | ≥22% | 11% |

  Implied median is about 19.0%.
- Related markets:
  - Kalshi Vox seats ≥65: 60%. Polymarket's mode is 66-70 seats.
  - PP+Vox at 50% or more of the vote: 46% on Kalshi, 48.5% on Polymarket.
  - Polymarket gives PP an 86.5% chance of winning.
- I found no Manifold market or published expert model for Vox's vote share beyond the poll aggregators.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Possible TV debates and the official campaign, which normally starts about 15 days before the vote, around 13 November.
- A November CIS barometer or a dedicated pre-election CIS survey (not confirmed). [Artículo14](https://www.articulo14.es/politica/el-cis-afronta-la-recta-final-hacia-el-29n-cuantas-encuestas-quedan-antes-de-las-elecciones-generales-20261014.html)
- Polls can no longer be published from 24 November.
- Continuing political fallout from the Urda crash.
- Election day is 29 November. Official proclamation follows in December, after the CERA count, which usually shifts shares by less than 0.1 point.

## 1. Resolution source
- The result will come from the Ministry of the Interior's results page (resultados.elecciones / infoelectoral) and from the proclaimed results of the Junta Electoral Central, published after election night on 2026-11-29. No 2026 figure exists yet. For reference, Vox got 12.39% of valid votes in 2023, with blank ballots counted as valid. [democrata.es](https://www.democrata.es/encuestas/elecciones-generales/encuesta-sociometrica-urda-pp-vox-suben-psoe/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The vote is on 2026-11-29. Sánchez called the snap election on 2026-10-05 after his housing decrees failed. [20minutos](https://www.20minutos.es/nacional/quien-ganara-elecciones-29-noviembre-segun-encuestas-sondeos_7044112_0.html)

## 4. Base rates
- Vox's past general election results: 0.2% (2015 and 2016), 10.3% (April 2019), 15.1% (November 2019), 12.4% (2023).
- How far final polls missed Vox (approximate, from memory, not checked against a source this session):
  - 2023: polls had about 13-14.5%, result 12.4, so polls were roughly 1-2 points too high.
  - November 2019: polls had about 13-14%, result 15.1, so polls were about 1-2 points too low.
  - April 2019: polls had about 11-13%, result 10.3, so polls were too high.
  - A typical miss is about ±1.5-2 points, in either direction.
- Trend in 2026 polls excluding CIS: January about 16.5-20.0%, April about 16.9-18.4%, July about 16.5-19.2%, late October about 18.6-20.2%. That is broadly stable to rising, with polls clustering more tightly near 19-20% during the campaign. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Opinion_polling_for_the_2026_Spanish_general_election)
- Andalusian regional election, 2026-05-17: PP won 41.6%; Vox won 15 seats (+1). One El Debate report says polls had Vox at 10.3% and it won 13.8%, which would mean polls underestimated Vox, but I could not verify that figure. [democrata.es](https://www.democrata.es/elecciones/andalucia-2026/resultados/), [El Debate](https://www.eldebate.com/cine-tv-series/20260518/tve-mete-vox-bloque-izquierdas-le-da-falsa-victoria-elecciones-andaluzas_418569.html)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The CIS pre-election macro-survey, expected mid-November, plus continuing private polls. Spanish law bans publishing polls in the final five days, so from about 2026-11-24.
- Campaign debates, and whether the political fallout from the Urda crash lasts.
- Turnout, and how much PP's "useful vote" appeal pulls votes from Vox. Mail-in voting is already contested (see Vox's request to the JEC).
- Election night on 2026-11-29. The scrutiny count with blank votes appears the same night. CERA (overseas) votes and official proclamation follow over the next weeks, and typically shift national shares by about 0.1 point or less.
